name: Streamshield
description: Automatically moderates user-generated nodes and comments by sending them to the Streamshield AI service, which can call back to unpublish flagged content.
project_description:
Integration module for Streamshield automated content moderation .

 Features 
 Quickly add automated content moderation to any Drupal user-generated content using Streamshield . Scan text, images, video, and audio from various file formats with a simple API key. Achieve instant compliance, safety, and peace of mind with transparency reporting. Key features include:

 
 Advanced machine learning models scan and categorize content at machine speed. 
 Automatically unpublish offensive content. 
 Detailed analytics and reports on all user-generated content. 
 Easy to use and quick to set up. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Once installed, go to Configuration - Streamshield - Registration to enter your domain access key and secret from the Streamshield platform.

 Once registered, go to Configuration - Streamshield - Content Types to choose which content types you want moderated.

 Additional Requirements 
 None

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 None
